summary: The appellant, a partnership firm, was carrying on business in partnership with the respondent, which was registered under a partnership deed dated March 12, 1948, and was registered as a partner in the firm. The firm was registered in the name of the firm and its partners were registered as partners in the partnership firm. In the assessment year 1948 49 the firm was assessed to income tax under the Income tax Act, 1922, and the Income Tax Officer assessed the firm as partners. The Income tax Officer assessed a firm as a partners in a partnership and assessed the partners as partners as a registered partner. The Appellate Assistant Commissioner held that the firm had not been registered as an partner in a firm. On appeal, the Appellate Assistant Collector held that there was no evidence to show that the partnership was registered and that the partners were not partners in any other firm. Held, that the Incometax Officer was not justified in rejecting the appeal of the assessee
